name: coding-agent-extension
description: A DeepSeek coding assistant with web search and SearXNG browsing.

codingAgent.searxngBaseUrl.description: Base URL of your SearXNG instance. Enable the JSON search format on that instance.

codingAgent.autoStartSearxng.description: Start the bundled local SearXNG Docker service automatically when VS Code starts.

codingAgent.autoInstallDocker.description: Install Docker Desktop automatically with Windows Package Manager when Docker is missing.

codingAgent.maxToolRounds.description: Maximum number of tool-operation rounds allowed for one Coding Agent turn.

codingAgent.model.description: DeepSeek model used by the extension. The startup check may update this setting.

codingAgent.autoCheckModelUpdates.description: Check DeepSeek documentation and update the configured model when the extension opens.

codingAgent.autoBackupToGitHub.description: Automatically commit and push workspace changes to a GitHub repository on an interval. Requires an authenticated GitHub CLI (run 'Coding Agent: Sign in to GitHub').

codingAgent.autoBackupIntervalMinutes.description: How often (in minutes) to automatically back up the workspace to GitHub.

codingAgent.promptForGitHubLogin.description: Show a status-bar indicator for GitHub login state and prompt to sign in when credentials are missing or expired.
